## MiniMax H3 Max Recast API

MiniMax H3 Max Recast is a video editing model by MiniMax, available on the Venice API as `minimax-h3-max-recast`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

### MiniMax H3 Max Recast API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minimax-h3-max-recast` | Video edit | Private | priced by source |

### MiniMax H3 Max Recast specifications

|---|---|

| Released | Oct 7, 2026 |

| Modes | video editing |

| Durations | Auto |
| Audio | None |

### How to use the MiniMax H3 Max Recast API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "minimax-h3-max-recast"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "minimax-h3-max-recast",
    "prompt": "Recast the person in the video as the person in the reference image",
    "resolution": "768P",
    "reference_image_urls": ["https://example.com/character.jpg"],
    "video_url": "https://example.com/source.mp4"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "minimax-h3-max-recast", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
